messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — LumenHealth consortium confirmed opt-in for our Q3 preview (20 seats across 3 product teams). Need to lock onboarding slots and feedback cadence. Who can own enablement + checklist?

jorge: I can run the enablement session w/ the SE playbook. prefer week-of Jul 12.

maya: perfect. can you also do a 1:1 for the security contacts? they asked about data retention and KMS.

jorge: yup. pinging @priya for the security + renewal angle.

priya: on it. i'll confirm whether they need Private (VPC) or Dedicated. raising a likely renewal risk: if they evaluate infra costs > threshold, renewal convo moves up. we'll surface cost/perf estimates.

theo: FYI — i'll prepare a small eval harness + a prompt set for conversational latency and hallucination checks. suggest collecting: 1) golden prompts, 2) error logs, 3) token-cost baseline.

maya: excellent. two asks for Jorge/theo: (1) onboarding checklist + session slide deck, (2) eval harness runbook and expected outputs. can we have drafts by EOD Tue?

jorge: working on slides. draft uploaded to docs: https://redwood.reviews/s/optin-lumen-07 — will add a short walkthrough and troubleshooting snippet.

onboard-bot: Added calendar placeholder "LumenHealth: Preview Enablement" for 2026-07-14 15:00 UTC. Attendees: maya, jorge, prinya.

priya: small correction — security lead is "Asha Patel" (asha@lumen). i'll intro via email after slides are ready. also adding a request: they need an exportable audit log for first 30 days.

theo: putting together eval checklist now. quick snippet of what i'll run:```
- perf: median p50/p95 latency (50, 300 tokens)
- cost: tokens per convo, batching impact
- quality: ROUGE/F1 on golden set + human pass/fail
- stability: error-rate per 1k requests
```

maya: love it. one more: capture customer qualitative feedback after session (one-pager + NPS star). can we automate a short survey that ties back to their account id and cohort tag?

jorge: yes. will add a short Google Form and webhook to create a ticket in Gainsight.

priya: also, heads-up — procurement may ask for SOC2 artifact copies. i've flagged compliance.

theo: quick prod note — if they opt for Dedicated, i'll recommend q4 quantization profile to reduce spend. will attach perf numbers to the deck.

maya: timeline summary:
- Tue EOD: slides + harness draft (jorge/theo)
- Wed: maya intro email to Asha + procurement
- Jul 14: enablement session booked
- 2 days post-session: survey + follow-up

maya: final question — any blockers?

jorge: none from my side. need confirmation on whether we'll include routing policies demo (cost vs latency).

priya: include it. it's a selling point for renewals.

maya: awesome. thanks all. i'll consolidate into a short confluence note after the slides land. :thumbsup:
